text: {"lessons":["Short-term price moves have been uneven, and past changes do not reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting to noise.","Holding through these periods has avoided unnecessary trades, but I should review each position on its merits rather than treat inaction as a rule.","My losses feel more painful than equal gains feel good, so I should use a consistent, risk-based plan instead of letting loss aversion or the urge to lock in gains drive decisions."]}
